## {.center background-image="img/mentors.png" data-menu-title="Mentors"}

## Getting 100+ petabytes data into scientists' hands is hard

::: {style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0px;"}
![](img/DAACS1.png){width="800"}

![](img/DAACS2.png){width="800"}

![](img/DAACS3.png){width="800"}
:::

::: notes
- NASA's Earth Science Data Systems Program manages 100+ petabytes of remote
  sensing data
- Feeds research all over the world: climate change & its impacts, landscape &
  ocean biology, water & atmospheric processes, and more
- The job of NASA staff across **11 different data centers** (DAACs)
- Each center builds its own tutorials for working with NASA Earthdata
- Traditionally siloed, with **duplicated effort** -- no shared place to
  collaborate
:::

## Enter the Earthdata Cloud Cookbook

::: columns
::::: {.column width="55%"}
- A Quarto-based website
- A growing, dynamic repository of tutorials & how-tos
- Brings together documentation + Python and R tutorials
- Meets the needs of both **users** and **contributors**
:::::
